synopsis: ICMM's Innovation for Cleaner, Safer Vehicles (ICSV) program brought mining companies and equipment makers together with a goal of making collision avoidance technology available to mining companies by 2025; this is a stated goal, not evidence that availability was achieved [f15613]. The program used Earth Moving Equipment Safety Round Table (EMESRT) requirements as its technical basis [f15614]. The glossary links the 2025 availability goal to mining customers' current expectations for intervention systems [f15624]. However, Chapter 12 says the program was not reviewed in its research, and the glossary says it was not reviewed in depth and is listed as not verified in Chapters 10, 12 and 13, limiting reliance on the booklet as a verification of the program [f9809, f15621].

relations.note: Broadens the Chapter 12 research gap to nonverification in Chapters 10, 12 and 13.
Identifies the technical requirements underpinning the program and its collision avoidance goal.
The stated 2025 availability goal underpins the explanation of customer expectations.
